summary: Iter_9 — Spell Compendium + CharacterBuilder spell-step verification. Backend CRUD (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/rules/spells) green via 3 new pytests. Frontend: /spells page renders 18 SRD spells anonymously, search/level/school/class/clear filters all narrow correctly. DM forge → edit → delete loop works end-to-end (toasts 'Homebrew spell forged' / 'Spell updated' / 'Spell deleted' all observed, orange Homebrew badge renders, Lv 3 reflects after edit, card disappears after confirmed delete). 'Homebrew only' toggle scopes to 1 card and untoggle restores full 19. CharacterBuilder spells step: 'Pick a class on the Identity step first' gate is fully removed (verified with no class selected), all 4 builder filter testids present and functional, Wickfire Lantern appears in picker list with orange 'HB' tag. Nav 'Spells' link sits between Magic and Shop. Anonymous DELETE/PUT correctly return 401/403.
critical_code_review_comments: Spells.jsx (~370 lines) — within the 700-line limit; well-scoped to the page concern.
Spells.jsx filtered useMemo correctly handles level==='' as 'all levels' (string vs number); robust.

SpellEditor.classes input has no data-testid (the spec lists editor-name/level/school/description but not classes). Tests had to fall back to placeholder selector — consider adding data-testid='editor-classes' for consistency.

CharacterBuilder.jsx spells step: hidden-slot heuristic `if (hidden && !Object.keys(spellSlots).includes(String(lvl))) return null;` still hides level rows whose max is 0 AND class has no spellcasting. Since the gate-removal expectation is 'always visible', consider always rendering all 9 levels (the user can manually crank 'max' up). Right now without a class chosen, only the levels already in state render — net effect: spell-slots grid can be empty until DM uses the +max buttons (which themselves only appear inside the row). Soft UX concern, not a blocker.
CharacterBuilder builder-spell list correctly tags homebrew spells with 'HB'; verified visually and via DOM (1 orange element when Wickfire is the sole homebrew).
API URLs use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (axios instance) — no hardcoded URLs in Spells.jsx.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleanly deleted 'Wickfire Lantern' homebrew spell during the test run. No persistent seed mutations remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 ships: (1) public /spells browser with full search/level/school/class/homebrew filters + Clear, (2) DM-only forge/edit/delete homebrew spells via modal (data-testid='spell-editor'), (3) CharacterBuilder spells step no longer gated on class.spellcasting and exposes builder-spell-search/level/school/class. Backend rules CRUD untouched and confirmed working. Wickfire Lantern was used as canonical test spell and cleaned up. The only minor cosmetic gap: SpellEditor 'Classes' input lacks a data-testid (use placeholder selector if needed). Nav order is Magic → Spells → Shop as specified.
rca of the issue: N/A — no broken flow. False-positive notes: my own playwright script used case-sensitive 'Lv 3' / 'Spell Slots' substring matching against CSS-uppercased text — the UI actually renders 'LV 3' and 'SPELL SLOTS' due to Tailwind `uppercase` class and `innerText` returns the rendered text. Both features verified visually via screenshots and via successful subsequent flows.
